name: Weekly Priority Briefing with Cron Setup
prompt:
Please act as my Personal Chief of Staff. On the desktop are my schedule for the past three months (calendar.ics), my to-do list (todo.md), and my goals document (goals.md, which states my annual goals and current priorities).
Please set up a weekly briefing mechanism: every Monday at 8 a.m., sort out “the three most important things this week” — judged by combining my long-term goals, the fixed arrangements on my calendar, and overdue unfinished items — and explain why each item matters and when it should be scheduled.
The first time, generate this week's briefing immediately and save it to /root/Desktop/weekly_briefing/; then also configure the scheduled task that automatically generates it every Monday, with the configuration file saved to /root/Desktop/weekly_briefing/schedule.json.

note:
Personal Chief of Staff
“Assume you are my personal assistant; tell me every Monday morning the three most important things this week.”

env_description: calendar.ics (next week's schedule + last week's leftovers) + todo.md (including overdue items) + goals.md (annual goal priorities); the three most important things this week need to be determined comprehensively and a scheduled task configured.
